title: When does aluminium-alloy quench transfer time end after the furnace door starts opening?
summary: Two 2021 Suneng aluminium-alloy quenching-furnace proposals time door opening to basket contact with the quenching medium separately from contact to complete entry of the effective zone, with four settings for the second stage. Rapid-quench assessment must define each start/end event and load orientation. The shortest setting is not the complete door-opening-to-full-immersion time.
